items.title: Nvidia’s CEO Change Won’t Derail AI Trade: Pepperstone
items.title_ko: Nvidia’s CEO Change Won’t Derail AI Trade: Pepperstone
items.summary_ko: Chris Weston, head of research at Pepperstone Group, said he doesn’t expect changes to Nvidia’s leadership to impact the outlook for the company. A new CEO will probably come with a deep knowledge of its business and will probably not change the rollout of products and direction of AI, he said.
